```{r Import Reichart}
Reichart <- readRDS("/scratch/gbonaz/Heart_datasets/Reichart_2022/DCM_ACM_heart_cell_atlas.rds")

  ensembl_id = rownames(Reichart),
```

```{r add metadata Reichart}
Clinical_data <- read_excel("/scratch/gbonaz/Heart_datasets/Reichart_2022/Reichart_et_al_Science_2022_Selected_clinical_info.xlsx")
add_metadata <- left_join(Reichart[["donor_id"]], Clinical_data)
row.names(add_metadata) <- row.names(Reichart[[]])
Reichart <- AddMetaData(Reichart, metadata = add_metadata)
rm(add_metadata, Clinical_data)
Reichart@meta.data[Reichart@meta.data$disease == "normal", "Group"] = "HC"
Reichart@meta.data[Reichart@meta.data$disease == "dilated cardiomyopathy", "Group"] = "DCM"
Reichart$Sample <- Reichart$donor_id
```

```{r}
Reichart_CM <- subset(Reichart, disease %in% c("dilated cardiomyopathy", "normal") & cell_type == "cardiac muscle cell")
Reichart_CM$Group <- factor(Reichart_CM$Group, levels = c("HC", "DCM"))
```

```{r Barplot_Group, fig.height=6, fig.width=5, message=FALSE}
props <- getTransformedProps(Reichart_CM$Phase, Reichart_CM$Group, transform="logit")

par(mar = c(7, 5, 1, 10), xpd = TRUE)
barplot(props$Proportions, legend = FALSE, ylab = "Proportions", col = c("#F8766D", "#00BA38", "#619CFF"), cex.names = 2, las = 2, font.lab = 2, font.axis = 2, cex.axis = 1.2, cex.lab = 2)
legend("topright", inset = c(-0.9, 0.3), legend = rownames(props$Proportions), fill = c("#F8766D", "#00BA38", "#619CFF"), bty = "n", cex = 2)
```

```{r Barplot_Region, fig.height=6, fig.width=5, message=FALSE}
props <- getTransformedProps(Reichart_CM$Phase, Reichart_CM$Region_x, transform="logit")

legend("topright", inset = c(-0.9, 0.3), legend = rownames(props$Proportions), fill = c("#F8766D", "#00BA38", "#619CFF"), bty = "n", cex = 2)
```

```{r Barplot_4, fig.height=6, fig.width=6, message=FALSE}
Reichart_CM$GroupRegion <- paste0(Reichart_CM$Group, "_", Reichart_CM$Region_x)

)

```

```{r}
Reichart_CM$GroupRegion <- paste0(Reichart_CM$Group, "_", Reichart_CM$Region_x)
Reichart_CM$GroupRegion <- factor(Reichart_CM$GroupRegion, levels = c("HC_LV", "HC_RV", "DCM_LV", "DCM_RV"))

# Per-patient percentages
df_patient_phase <- Reichart_CM@meta.data %>%
  group_by(donor_id, GroupRegion, Phase) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(donor_id, GroupRegion) %>%   # <- fix: include GroupRegion
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

df_patient_phase$GroupRegion <- factor(
  df_patient_phase$GroupRegion,
  levels = c("HC_LV", "HC_RV", "DCM_LV", "DCM_RV")
)

comparisons <- list(
  c("HC_RV", "DCM_RV"),
  c("HC_LV", "DCM_LV"),
  c("HC_RV", "HC_LV"),
  c("DCM_RV", "DCM_LV")
)
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=4}
plots <- list()

for (ph in c("G1", "S", "G2M")) {

  df_sub <- df_patient_phase %>% filter(Phase == ph)

  p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(GroupRegion, pct, fill = GroupRegion)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      hide.ns = FALSE,
      label = "p.signif"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Phase: ", ph),
      y = "Percentage of cells",
      x = ""
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )

  plots[[ph]] <- p
}
plots
```
